overview.title: ZenUI Library React
overview.intro: ZenUI is your ultimate destination for a comprehensive collection of UI components and designs, all available for free. Whether you're building a website from scratch or enhancing an existing one, ZenUI has everything you need to bring your vision to life.
overview.about_desc_1: ZenUI is a developer-friendly platform designed to accelerate your workflow and inspire creativity. It offers a rich collection of meticulously crafted components that help you build modern, responsive, and visually appealing web interfaces with ease.
overview.about_desc_2_prefix: Our ecosystem includes ZenUI for React/Next.js and ZenUI for
overview.about_desc_2_suffix: , providing robust, framework-specific libraries that integrate seamlessly into your projects. Every component is reusable, customizable, and built following contemporary design standards to ensure consistency and performance.
overview.reusable_components_desc: Access a suite of highly customizable, production-ready components built with best practices in mind. From complex forms to interactive tabs and accordions, these components save development time while ensuring consistency across your project.
overview.templates_desc: Choose from a variety of pre-built multi-page templates, perfect for businesses, blogs, and more. These templates are crafted to help you quickly establish an online presence.
overview.blocks_desc: Access a wide range of essential UI blocks that you can mix and match to create unique page layouts effortlessly.
overview.icons_desc: Our growing library of SVG icons provides a modern touch to any project, with easy integration and customization options.
overview.animated_desc: Bring your website to life with a collection of ready-to-use animated components using Framer-Motion. These subtle yet impactful animations improve user engagement and provide a polished, professional look to any design.
overview.color_palette_desc: Introducing the custom color opacity palette. A versatile tool that allows you to explore different opacity variations of colors. Simply paste your color code, and the palette will generate a range of opacity levels along with the corresponding HEX, RGB, and HSL codes. Clicking on a color code instantly copies it to your clipboard, making color management a breeze.
overview.no_dependencies_desc: ZenUI is entirely standalone, just copy the code and use it. No external dependencies or additional setups are required, making integration fast and hassle-free.
overview.customizability_desc: Our codes are very structured so you can customize them to your liking. You can customize the components according to your business logic.
overview.design_desc: All the components follow the ZenUI modern design. So you don't have to redesign to use them. More exciting thing is that since there is no need to design, you save your designing time.
overview.prebuild_desc: ZenUI has many pre-built web templates. You can create a website without using them without any code. We have tried to follow the most modern design by following the design. The ZenUI contains 20+ web templates.
overview.community_desc: ZenUI is more than just a library it's a community. Join other developers, share your work, get feedback, and collaborate to push the boundaries of what's possible.

installation.title: Installation Guide
installation.intro_1_prefix: ZenUI Library React is designed to be
installation.intro_1_suffix: . Unlike many libraries that need to be installed via npm or similar package managers, ZenUI components can be directly copied and pasted into your existing project. This means there is no need to install ZenUI itself.
installation.intro_2: However, for ZenUI components to work correctly, your project needs to be set up with specific tools and frameworks like Tailwind CSS, React, or Next.js. These are the fundamental technologies that power the ZenUI components, as they are built using Tailwind CSS for styling and compatible with popular frameworks like React.
installation.why_desc: ZenUI is a library of pre-built components and blocks that can be directly inserted into your project’s code. It doesn’t function as a JavaScript package that needs installation. Instead, you can copy the component’s HTML and Tailwind CSS classes from ZenUI and immediately use them in your application, making it incredibly flexible and easy to integrate.
installation.icon_warning_prefix: Some ZenUI components may include icons. To ensure these components display correctly, you will need to install the
installation.icon_warning_suffix: package if you're using React. This package provides a wide range of icons that can be easily integrated into your components. You can install it via npm
installation.requirements_desc: While ZenUI doesn’t have its own installation, you’ll need to ensure that your project is already configured with the necessary tools, depending on the type of project you're working on. Below are the common setups you’ll need for ZenUI components:
installation.req_tailwind_desc: If you're building a project with plain HTML or any framework, ensure that you have Tailwind CSS installed for styling. ZenUI components are styled using Tailwind CSS, so having it set up is essential.
installation.req_react_desc: If you're using React, Tailwind CSS should be installed and configured in your React project. ZenUI components can be used directly in your JSX files once Tailwind is set up.
installation.req_next_desc: ZenUI components can also be used in a Next.js project, but again, Tailwind CSS needs to be configured first.
installation.setup_desc: Since ZenUI doesn’t need any installation, we can help by providing guidance on how to set up a basic project environment that will allow you to use ZenUI components.

installation.setup_next_desc: If you're building a Next.js project, you can easily integrate Tailwind CSS by following the guide below:
installation.final_note: By following the setup guides for Tailwind CSS, React, or Next.js, you'll be ready to use ZenUI components right away! If you need help setting up your project, refer to the links provided above for detailed instructions.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Find quick answers to common queries
faq.a1: ZenUI Library React is a free collection of UI components and templates designed for developers and businesses. It offers a variety of pre-built components, website templates, essential blocks, and SVG icons to help speed up web development.
faq.q2: Is ZenUI Library React free to use?
faq.a2: Yes, ZenUI Library React is completely free to use. It provides high-quality UI components and templates at no cost, making it accessible to everyone.
faq.q3: Can I customize the components in ZenUI Library React?
faq.a3: Absolutely! All components in ZenUI Library React are fully customizable. You can modify them to fit your project's design requirements using your preferred CSS framework or custom styles.
faq.q4: Do I need to attribute ZenUI Library React when using it in my projects?
faq.a4: Attribution is appreciated but not required. You're free to use ZenUI Library React in your projects without needing to give credit, although a mention would help support the project.
faq.q5: How often is ZenUI Library React updated?
faq.a5: ZenUI Library React is regularly updated with new components, templates, and features. The team behind ZenUI is committed to keeping the library fresh and relevant to current design trends.
faq.q6: Is ZenUI Library React compatible with React and Vue?
faq.a6: Yes, you can use every component in ZenUI Library React with your React, Tailwind CSS, and Next.js projects. However, compatibility with Vue is coming soon, so stay tuned for updates!
faq.q7: Can I contribute to ZenUI Library React?
faq.a7: Yes, contributions are welcome! If you’re a designer or developer who wants to contribute to the ZenUI Library React, you can submit your components or templates. Your contributions will be credited on the website's 'About Us' section.
faq.q8: What is the difference between ZenUI and other UI libraries?
faq.a8: ZenUI Library React stands out for its focus on simplicity and ease of use. It’s designed to be lightweight, customizable, and accessible, making it ideal for developers who need quick, high-quality solutions without the bloat of larger libraries. Additionally, unlike many other UI libraries, you don't need to install ZenUI Library React in your project—just copy the code and use it without any dependencies. This makes integration fast and hassle-free.
faq.q9: Is there any documentation available for ZenUI Library React?
faq.a9: Yes, ZenUI Library React provides detailed documentation for each component and template. The documentation includes usage instructions, code examples, and customization tips to help you get started quickly.
faq.q10: How can I stay updated on ZenUI Library React releases?
faq.a10: You can stay updated by following ZenUI Library React on social media, subscribing to the newsletter, or checking the official website regularly. Updates and new releases are announced through these channels.
